openQuestions.q: Should agent-prompt-story-full-assembly verify only dispatchKind=story-dispatch, leaving dispatchKind=review-run entirely to CHK-003/review_run_start?
openQuestions.evidence: The updated plan and existing PromptEnvelope contract define dispatchKind as story-dispatch|review-run; CHK-002 says agent_prompt accepts only role/storyId/format and returns story-dispatch. The updated intent instead asserts dispatchKind=audit and says reviewer-authority requests resolve through agent_prompt, introducing an invalid discriminator and a request path the plan forbids.
